bio.text: Ed Gallrein, a Republican from Shelby County, Kentucky, is the Republican candidate for Kentucky's 4th Congressional District after defeating incumbent Rep. Thomas Massie in the May 2026 primary.
Spectrum News describes him as a fifth-generation farmer and former Navy SEAL.
According to his campaign website, he was born and raised in Kentucky and served a career spanning three decades in uniform as a Navy SEAL officer, rising to the rank of Captain.

sources.title: Former Navy SEAL Gallrein seeks to flip Trump endorsement into House seat
